CANONICAL_NAME.value: LINPACK benchmark, double precision (linpackd) -- Dongarra, Bunch, Moler, Stewart

VERSION.value: netlib.org/benchmark/linpackd as served 2026-09-12 (file carries its own 'linpack benchmark' revision comments)

value.lineage: LINPACK (1979, Argonne / U New Mexico / Sandia / Michigan): LU factorisation with partial pivoting (DGEFA/DGESL) over the BLAS-1 kernels (DAXPY, DDOT, DSCAL, IDAMAX); the benchmark that defined machine performance for two decades

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: dense linear solve with pivoting; the LINPACK MFLOPS number

value.built_to: solve dense systems of linear equations Ax=b reliably on the machines of the late 1970s, and (as the benchmark) measure how fast a machine does it
value.pressure: numerical stability under floating-point round-off (partial pivoting), and portability across vendors' Fortran compilers
value.success_means: a small normalised residual on the solved system; for the benchmark, MFLOPS on the 100x100 problem
